result.summary: Design artefact written to lib/letflow/design/iss0782-identity-api-route-fix.md. Covers all 5 in-scope call sites from the ISSUE-FIXER diagnosis with exact before/after path literals (usersApi.list: /api/v1/users -> /api/v1/identity/users; usersApi.get: /api/v1/users/:id -> /api/v1/identity/users/:id; usersApi.create: /api/v1/admin/users -> /api/v1/identity/users; usersApi.update: /api/v1/users/:id -> /api/v1/identity/users/:id; rolesApi.list: /api/v1/admin/roles -> /api/v1/identity/roles), each tied to its source line in web/src/api/identity.ts (16, 19, 22, 25, 66). Confirms pure string-literal change: no new/changed TypeScript types, no change to client.ts or any HTTP wrapper, no request/response JSON shape change (real backend already returns the same User/Role/PagedResponse shapes these functions already declare), no caller-side wiring changes needed in useAdminUsers.ts/UsersPage.tsx/UserDetailPage.tsx. States explicitly no shim/adapter/normalization layer is introduced -- each path literal is edited in place, no new file/module/interceptor. Scope section documents the decision to leave groupsApi.list (also broken, also reachable from UserDetailPage.tsx via useAdminGroups) to ISS-0765 rather than folding it in here, and explicitly flags the residual gap: UserDetailPage's group-membership section stays broken until ISS-0765 is worked, even though the Users list/create/edit flows are fully fixed by this design. Also explicitly scopes out usersApi.resetPassword/.delete (no matching backend route at any prefix -- separate missing-backend-endpoint gap), and rolesApi.get/.create/.update/.delete/.grantPermission/.revokePermission plus tokensApi.* (not called by the Users admin screen). Notes web/tests/e2e/f5-admin-users.e2e.spec.ts as an existing live-backend e2e asset for TEST-DESIGNER to decide whether to reuse as the fail-then-pass regression test or augment, without designing the test itself, and flags identity.removeMembers.test.ts's mocked-fetch-assertion convention as a reasonable complementary pattern per the diagnosis's own suggestion. Includes an acceptance-criteria-to-design-element mapping table and an explicit 'no open questions' close -- all five call sites and the scope boundary were fully resolved by the diagnosis handoff, nothing left for ELIXIR-DEV/FRONTEND-DEV to guess at. No implementation code included -- only literal before/after path strings inside prose/markdown, no .ts code fences with function bodies.
